reviewer.attestation: Reviewed only the contributed JSON and live repository/test sources; decisions reflect development evidence and anchor-to-behavior alignment, not hypothetical hidden fixes.

findings: Scheduler dequeue behavior lives in tier1_enqueue/tier1_dequeue, while changing KERNEL_MAGIC and renumbering Alloca alters boot/VFS identity and the global IR ABI instead of ring-wrap logic.
Process-index tombstone probing is implemented in PID_INDEX/ulib_hmap tombstone code; STORAGE_BLOCK_WORDS and Param = 0 change storage geometry and opcode numbering rather than probe behavior.
Timer cancellation under bucket reuse should touch TIMER_WHEEL scheduling paths, but MMU_PAGE_WORDS is page geometry and Const = 2 is only an explicit no-op ordinal.
Extent coalescing belongs in VFS extent management, not MMU_SUPERPAGE_WORDS, and Copy = 3 merely restates the existing opcode value.
Window FIFO behavior is in window_queue_event/window_read_event and WIN_EVENT_* state; PTR_STATE_NULL plus Add = 4 does not target queue ordering.
Negative odd half-division is math_utils lowering logic, while PTR_STATE_UNKNOWN is pointer classification and Sub = 5 is an explicit no-op ordinal.
WAL checksum rejection is exercised in ternary_redo_wal replay/checksum paths; PTR_STATE_VALID and Mul = 6 are unrelated to wrapped-lane validation.
Signed boundary conversion lives in ternary_lanes.h and its tests, but ERR_NOT_FOUND and Div = 7 do not touch lane conversion semantics.
Spill metadata survives in tcl_backend spill/local-lowering code; ERR_EXISTS and Tmod = 8 neither anchor nor implement that compiler interaction.
Phi predecessor canonicalization is covered in test_phase7_compiler phi recovery cases, while ERR_NO_SPACE and Cvt = 9 are unrelated surfaces.
Executable ABI vector call-area width is enforced by codegen and test_executable_abi_v3, not by ERR_BAD_FD, and Cmp = 10 is only the existing opcode ordinal.
No module-initialization ordering evidence points to ERR_BAD_PTR or Tsel = 11; the proposed mutations do not reach any real ordering mechanism.
Checked constant-folding trap behavior is tested in compiler/runtime paths, but ERR_NOT_DIR and Phi = 12 do not participate in folding or trap preservation.
Wrapped end-address rejection is implemented in user_validate_span; ERR_IS_DIR and FieldAddr = 13 are unrelated to span arithmetic or validation.
Generation invalidation should land in arena/generation bookkeeping, not ERR_INVALID, and IndexAddr = 14 only restates the current opcode number.
Join-path move-permission clearing is exercised in compiler move-analysis tests, whereas ERR_EOF and AddrOf = 15 do not touch that dataflow.
IPC wake-generation handoff lives in wait/scheduler wake paths; ERR_TIMEOUT and Deref = 16 do not implement or evidence a single-generation wake contract.
Redo replay fence handling belongs in WAL replay/commit-chain logic, not ERR_AGAIN, and Load = 17 is a no-op explicit ordinal.
Quota refill promotion should modify scheduler/quota code, but ERR_CANCELED and Store = 18 do not reach priority-queue refill behavior.
Keeping syscall status and payload registers distinct belongs in syscall wrappers/ABI packing, while SYS_BLOCKED and SpillLoad = 19 are unrelated.
Rename wrapper path preservation is an SDK/syscall buffer-copy concern, not KIND_FREE, and SpillStore = 20 only restates the current opcode value.
The kernel KIND_FILE constant is unrelated to loader ABI checks, and the ternary_compiler_ir.h anchor does not match the live file verbatim; even isolated, Syscall = 21 would be a no-op ordinal.
Application feature-mask agreement is implemented in build_tos_image.cpp and APP_MANIFEST surfaces, not KIND_DIR, and Wait = 22 only restates the existing opcode value.
Second-payload section alignment is an image/migration concern, while KIND_EXEC and TlbInv = 23 do not touch layout or packing logic.
Transitive Trit import discovery lives in tools/generate_source_manifests.py, not BOOTSTRAP_MAX_PAGES, and Fence = 24 merely repeats the current opcode ordinal.
Namespace-default quota persistence is handled by quota load/sync paths in kernel.trit, whereas BOOTSTRAP_RESERVED_PAGES and Tldr = 25 are unrelated.
Canonical guest paths and app registry generation are built in build_tos_image.cpp and validated by app/consumer-shell tests, not BOOTSTRAP_KERNEL_IMAGE_PAGES, and Tstr = 26 is a no-op ordinal.
Configured build-directory forwarding already runs through trit_tool.py default_build_dir/cmd_test and wrapper tests; BOOTSTRAP_BUFFER_POOL_HEADER_PAGES and Csrr = 27 do not target the runner path.
Production discovery for nested Windows shards would need runner/discovery changes, but tools/trit-test.ps1 is only a trampoline and BOOTSTRAP_WAL_RING_PAGES plus Csrw = 28 do not touch discovery.
Deterministic evidence ordering is already implemented with canonicalization and sorted traversals in generate_source_manifests.py; KERNEL_STATE_BASE and Csrrw = 29 are unrelated.
Release-staging image metadata should anchor in staging/image-builder dependencies, not KERNEL_BOOTED_ADDR, and Call = 30 only restates the current opcode value.
Page-local permission caching belongs in translation-span/TLB or VM permission-key logic, whereas BOOT_ALLOC_COUNT_ADDR and CallR = 31 do not implement that cache.
Packed lane transform behavior belongs in lane/vector lowering or VM vector ops, not REL_ONLINE_ADDR, and Ret = 32 simply restates the current opcode ordinal.
